title: Final Probability
description: Essential Criteria: The final probability of 9/16 must be correctly calculated and presented.

title: Total Steps Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The total number of possible step combinations (64) must be correctly determined.

title: Out of Circle Paths
description: Important Criteria: The identification and counting of paths that lead out of the circle must be accurate.

title: Combination Usage
description: Important Criteria: The correct application of combinations (C) in counting paths must be shown.

title: Probability Formula
description: Optional Criteria: The use of the probability formula P = 1 - (out of circle paths / total paths) should be clearly stated.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign errors in the final probability calculation will lead to a deduction.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any mistakes in maintaining consistent units throughout the problem will result in a deduction.
